Report_ID: Activity limitation / ankle function at end of treatment (Mazur functional ankle score at 6 weeks)
Title: Functional outcome of surgery for fractures of the ankle: a prospective, randomised comparison of management in a cast or a functional brace
Author: Egol, Dolan & Koval
Comment: M_diff computed as group_2_mean - group_1_mean (56.5 - 52.4) from explicitly reported means of a simple two-group between-subjects comparison. Groups compared with Mann-Whitney U; medians and ranges also reported.
Participant type: skeletally mature adults with closed isolated unstable ankle fracture treated by ORIF
Recruitment source: Consecutive surgical patients, Hospital for Joint Diseases, New York
Outcome measurement: Mean (SD) functional ankle score at 6 weeks, compared with Mann-Whitney U test
Outcome variable: Activity limitation / ankle function at end of treatment (Mazur functional ankle score at 6 weeks)
effect_direction: favours removable brace (higher Mazur score 56.5 vs 52.4, p=0.028)
outcome_units: points on the Mazur, Schwartz and Simon ankle score

Report_ID: Activity limitation / ankle function (modified Olerud ankle score) at 10 weeks (end of treatment)
Title: Ankle Performance after Ankle Fracture: A Randomized Study of Early Mobilization
Author: Tropp & Norlin
Comment: No between-group test statistic or p-value reported; only the narrative "no significant difference between the groups". Per-group n=15 inferred from Methods (30 consecutive patients randomized) and Results ("15 patients in the brace group").
Participant type: Adults aged 18-60 with Danis-Weber B or C ankle fracture treated by ORIF
Outcome variable: Activity limitation / ankle function (modified Olerud ankle score) at 10 weeks (end of treatment)
effect_direction: favours removable brace (77 vs 70 points, not statistically significant)

Report_ID: Olerud Molander ankle score (OMAS) at 6 weeks
Title: Use of cast immobilisation versus removable brace in adults with an ankle fracture: multicentre randomised controlled trial
Author: Kearney et al.
Comment: M_diff is the adjusted between-group difference (positive favours removable brace); SE_diff derived as (5.8-(-1.4))/3.92 = 1.837 from the reported 95% CI. Unadjusted difference was 2.4 (-1.4 to 6.2).
Participant type: Adults aged 18 years and older with an acute closed ankle fracture suitable for cast immobilisation
Outcome measurement: Self-reported ankle function score, higher = better function
Outcome variable: Olerud Molander ankle score (OMAS) at 6 weeks
effect_direction: slightly favours removable brace (39.6 vs 37.2 OMAS; adjusted difference 2.2, 95% CI -1.4 to 5.8, p=0.23)

Title: Early Weightbearing and Range of Motion vs Non-Weightbearing and Immobilization After Open Reduction and Internal Fixation of Unstable Ankle Fractures: A Randomized Controlled Trial
Author: Dehghan et al.
Comment: Means reported in text without standard deviations or timepoint-specific group Ns; group Ns taken from randomisation (56 Early WB, 54 Late WB). Report_ID: Olerud & Molander functional score at week 6 (end of immobilisation period)
Title: Early Active Mobilization Versus Cast Immobilization in Operatively Treated Ankle Fractures: A Prospective Analysis of Early Functional Recovery
Author: Siddique, Prasad, O'Connor
Comment: M_diff computed as group_2_mean − group_1_mean (33.0 − 39.2) from explicitly reported means in a simple two-group between-subjects comparison; group_1 is the intervention (mobilized) arm as listed first in the paper's Table 2. df1 inferred as n1+n2−2 for the independent t-test. Scale range of the Olerud & Molander score not explicitly stated, so scale min/max left empty.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Mobilized group (left free of plaster casting postoperatively, immediate non-weight-bearing active mobilization)') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Participant type: Adults aged 16-60 with isolated Weber "B" lateral malleolar or bimalleolar ankle fracture treated by ORIF
Recruitment source: Four accident and emergency departments in the hospital catchment area
Outcome measurement: Mean (SD) functional score per group; independent t-test
Outcome variable: Olerud & Molander functional score at week 6 (end of immobilisation period)
effect_direction: favours early mobilisation / non-cast group (39.2 vs 33.0, p=0.29, not significant)

Title: Weight-bearing or non-weight-bearing after surgical treatment of ankle fractures: a multicenter randomized controlled trial
Author: Smeeing et al.
Comment: The reported p = 0.011 is the omnibus one-way ANOVA p value across all THREE arms, not the pairwise unprotected vs. protected weight-bearing contrast (pairwise comparisons are in Appendix 3, not available in the provided text).
